title: Exploring Language Patterns in a Medical Licensure Exam Item Bank

bias_targets.methodology: Predicting patient gender from exam item stems using machine learning and NLP models (e.g., Logistic Regression, SciBERT, BioClinicalBERT), alongside topic modeling (LDA) and biomedical Named Entity Recognition (NER) to identify stereotypical language patterns.

Predicting patient age ranges from exam item stems using machine learning and contextual language models, combined with topic modeling and NER to detect age-specific stereotypical language patterns in clinical scenarios.
